export.description: A CDC WONDER query result, exported from the WONDER web site (Export, tab-delimited .txt) and uploaded: deaths, populations and rates by the Group By fields chosen, e.g. underlying cause of death by year, state, age, sex, race. Manual only: wonder.cdc.gov refuses this client.

database.desc: the WONDER database the query ran on, as WONDER names it (e.g. 'Underlying Cause of Death, 2018-2023, Single Race'), cited with the result

query.desc: what the query selected and grouped by, in words (for INSTRUCTIONS.md and the citation)
